title: Director of Power SCADA
description:
**Who We Are**:  
Atlas Energy Solutions Inc. (NYSE: AESI) is a leading solutions provider to the energy industry. Atlas’ portfolio of offerings includes oilfield logistics, distributed power systems, and the largest proppant supply network in the Permian Basin. With a focus on leveraging technology, automation, and remote operations to enhance efficiencies, Atlas is centered around a core mission of improving human beings’ access to hydrocarbons that power our lives and, by doing so, maximizing value creation for our shareholders.

**How You Will Make an Impact:**

The **Director of Power SCADA** leads the design, build, and ongoing operation of enterprise SCADA, historian, and related systems across the Atlas prime power fleet. This role aligns technical standards, commissioning, and system support to deliver reliable power plant operations.

**Responsibilities**

**SCADA strategy and delivery**

* + Lead planning, design, buildout, and operation of enterprise SCADA, historian, and related fleet systems.
  + Coordinate OT buildout and testing with the Director of Controls Engineering, staff, and contractors.
  + Develop enterprise SCADA standards and OT network architecture plans; lead field commissioning activities.
  + Collaborate with engineering, purchasing, production, manufacturing engineering, cybersecurity, the Generation Dispatch Desk, and plant management and staff.

**Technical assurance and development**

* + Supervise, review, and approve the technical work of vendors, contractors, and junior engineers.
  + Verify design and performance specifications through reviews and testing with controls engineers and product specialists.
  + Mentor junior engineers and establish consistent design, commissioning, and testing documentation.
  + Lead root-cause analysis and implement system modifications and corrective actions.

**Operational reliability and safety**

* + Provide technical support for enterprise power systems and resolve SCADA and historian issues.

title: Director of Energy Storage Modeling and Design
description: ROLE OVERVIEW Pivot Energy is seeking a motivated individual to join our Technical Operations team and lead the company’s Energy Storage modeling and design. The role covers market analysis, technical vendor evaluation, pricing, modeling, sizing, and design recommendations for our storage (DC-coupled with PV solar and standalone storage) project pipeline. This role combines aspects of engineering, collaboration with finance, operations, and policy teams with a goal of deploying and optimizing our storage pipeline. The Director will be responsible for technical analysis of all solar- plus-storage (DC-coupled) and standalone energy storage market opportunities, including optimal system sizing. The Director will work with the market strategy, policy, and finance teams on revenue modeling and financial analysis, and with Estimation, Procurement, and Commercial Operations to optimize CAPEX and OPEX. The role also works regularly with project development leads and cross-team leads in Project Development Origination, Grid Interconnection, Engineering, Finance, Delivery, O&M, and Asset Management.The Director will have the opportunity to identify and vet potential areas of new energy storage business development, such as new geographies, programs, incentives, or procurements. This is an opportunity to join a small team in a fast-growing market at an exciting and expanding company. This position offers significant growth potential at a B Corporation with operations across the USA.
